## Brine Dragon, Juvenile (CR 8)

**XP** 4,800  
 LN Medium dragon (water)  
 **Init** +5; **Senses** dragon senses; Perception +15

**Defense**

 **AC** 23, touch 11, flat-footed 22 (+1 Dex, +12 natural)  
 **hp** 95 (10d12+30)  
 **Fort** +10, **Ref** +10, **Will** +9  
 **Immune** acid, paralysis, sleep  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 60 ft., fly 150 ft. (average), swim 60 ft.  
 **Melee** bite +18 (1d8+12), 2 claws +18 (1d6+8), 2 wings +13 (1d4+4)  
 **Special Attacks** breath weapon (60-ft. line, 8d6 acid, DC 18)  
 **Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 10th; concentration +12)  

  At will—*[obscuring mist](../../magic/spells/obscuring-mist.md)*, *[speak with animals](../../magic/spells/speak-with-animals.md)* (fish only), *[water breathing](../../magic/spells/water-breathing.md)*

 **Spells Known** (CL 3rd; concentration +5)  

 1st (6/day)—*[color spray](../../magic/spells/color-spray.md)* (DC 13), *[flare burst](../../magic/spells/flare-burst.md)** (DC 13), *[touch of the sea](../../magic/spells/touch-of-the-sea.md)**  
 0 (at will)—*[detect magic](../../magic/spells/detect-magic.md)*, *[mage hand](../../magic/spells/mage-hand.md)*, *[open/close](../../magic/spells/open-close.md)*, *[prestidigitation](../../magic/spells/prestidigitation.md)*, *[read magic](../../magic/spells/read-magic.md)*  

 ** – denotes spell from Advanced Player’s Guide.*

**Statistics**

 **Str** 26, **Dex** 13, **Con** 17, **Int** 17, **Wis** 14, **Cha** 15  
 **Base Atk** +10; **CMB** +18; **CMD** 29 (33 vs. trip)  
 **Feats** Hover, Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes, Power Attack, Skill Focus (Swim)  
 **Skills** Bluff +15, Diplomacy +15
